description: A model's MOT reliability over all years: grade, first-time pass rate, points above or below a typical car of the same age and mileage, and the share of UK cars it beats. Give year, fuel and/or engine to also get those versions, each with its own grade and the areas where it fails more often than similar cars (weak spots).

engine.description: Engine size in litres, e.g. 1.0 (or cc, e.g. 999).

make.description: Car make, e.g. Ford, VW or Mercedes-Benz.

model.description: Model name, e.g. Fiesta, Golf or Qashqai.

name: get_model_reliability
title: Reliability of a car model
